propositions: The close precheck unconditionally dispatches the LLM completion verifier via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already contains a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the exact resolved close SHA.
A valid stored completion op-cert with authenticated PASS status, matching SHA pin, and current material fingerprint must be reused during close to avoid redundant provider invocation.

Attestations invalidated by stale material fingerprint, changed resolved ref, post-reopen lifecycle state, missing or mismatched SHA pin, missing material fingerprint, invalid signature, or non-PASS status must fall through to fresh provider verification.

The reuse check must authenticate the stored completion op-cert cryptographically and compare its verified-at-sha and material fingerprint against the resolved close target before deciding to skip provider dispatch.
A close at the exact SHA of a valid stored completion PASS must produce zero completion-provider calls while maintaining signed closed ticket and durable completion evidence.

All nine negative controls—changed ref, invalid signature, FAIL status, wrong record kind, missing SHA, missing material, material drift, post-reopen staleness, and unverifiable cert—must each force exactly one fresh provider verification.
